notes: Games. Every game now has a rules button — the goal, then a turn in the order it happens, for anyone who has never played it. Chess pieces are carved instead of typed, basketball gained a real gym and bowling a real lane, the dice are dice, and Lumen Run's maze looks built rather than drawn. Connect Four discs now fall through the holes and settle, instead of appearing where you tapped. War's tie rule was wrong and cost four cards a side; it is three now, and you can play a full deck with twenty-six cards each. A board that was bigger than the screen — Sudoku on a phone — now fits, and finishing a game no longer resizes the board underneath you.
